convergence.verdict: DEEPER: V4.1 found 26 findings (4 P1) vs V4 8 findings (0 P1). The P1 findings are new discoveries at deeper analytical layers (unsafe audit, panic safety, error path coverage), not regressions.

findings.title: ap-cli re-spawns processes instead of using ap-runtime AgentProcess
findings.description: ap-cli directly uses std::process::Command for daemon spawning instead of reusing ap-runtime AgentProcess, creating parallel implementations.
findings.fix: Refactor ap-cli to use ap-runtime AgentProcess or document the design reason.

findings.title: Evolver concurrent modification detection uses string matching on error message
findings.description: The evolver detects concurrent modifications by checking if SQLite error message contains UNIQUE constraint. Fragile across SQLite versions/locales.
findings.fix: Use rusqlite error code matching (SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE) instead of string matching.

findings.title: ap-cli uses anyhow for all errors losing typed error context
findings.description: All CLI commands return anyhow::Result. Cannot programmatically distinguish error types.
findings.fix: Define CLI-specific error enums for machine-consumable error reporting.

findings.title: init --dir error messages do not distinguish validation failures from I/O errors
findings.description: validate_init_dir returns io::Error for validation failures, mixing policy errors with OS errors.
findings.fix: Use a dedicated InitError enum to separate validation errors from I/O errors.
findings.fix_detail: Added InitError enum separating PathTraversal/SystemDirectory/Io variants

findings.title: tokio::spawn in run_daemon without JoinHandle storage
findings.description: tokio::spawn called but JoinHandle not stored. Cannot detect panics or cancellation of background daemon task.
findings.fix: Store JoinHandle and check for errors on shutdown.
findings.fix_detail: Collect JoinHandles in Vec, check finished handles for panics after spawn loop

findings.title: Only McpClient trait in 22.9K LOC - limited polymorphism for gateway and evolution
findings.description: EvolutionStore, GitInstaller, TaskGraph are concrete types. Testing requires real I/O backends.
findings.fix: Introduce Store and Installer traits when test friction demands it.
findings.trigger: When unit testing without SQLite becomes a bottleneck

findings.title: std::mem::forget(child) leaves zombie processes with no reaping mechanism
findings.description: run_daemon calls mem::forget on child process to daemonize. Resulting zombie is never reaped.
findings.fix: Reaper thread with child.wait() instead of mem::forget.

findings.title: ManuallyDrop + forget uses two different mechanisms for same goal
findings.description: AgentProcess::split uses ManuallyDrop::take + mem::forget, while ap-cli uses raw mem::forget. Two patterns for same operation.
findings.fix: Standardize on one approach across the workspace.
findings.fix_detail: Patterns serve different layers (ManuallyDrop for struct extraction, forget for consumer escape hatch); SAFETY comment documents rationale

findings.title: ap-runtime re-exports ap-core types without adding value
findings.description: LockRegistry is a pure type alias re-export. AgentProtocol wraps IpcProtocol with near-identical methods.
findings.fix: Remove or document as intentional facade.
findings.trigger: When ap-runtime gains its own logic

findings.title: Two unsafe kill() calls lack documented PID validity guarantee
findings.description: kill(pid, 0) and kill(pid, SIGTERM) called with PID from file. PID may be stale. Unsafe blocks lack safety comments.
findings.fix: Add SAFETY comments explaining PID validity contract. [APPLIED]

findings.title: Deferred registry activate() has unwrap after OnceCell race
findings.description: slot.tools.get().unwrap() relies on OnceCell being set. Invariant holds but lacks documentation.
findings.fix: Replace unwrap with expect() for better diagnostics. [APPLIED]

findings.title: Gateway health endpoint error not covered by IntoResponse
findings.description: RegistryError does not implement IntoResponse. Future refactor adding registry access to health endpoint would fail at compile time.
findings.fix: Already mitigated: #[from] RegistryError converts to GatewayError which implements IntoResponse with exhaustive match.

findings.title: Evolver concurrent modification not tested with actual concurrent access
findings.description: ConcurrentModification error tested by sequential calls, not actual concurrent access.
findings.fix: Add multi-threaded test for concurrent evolution.
findings.fix_detail: Added multi-threaded test with Barrier synchronization using file-based DB

findings.title: Topological sort .expect() can panic on corrupted SQLite data
findings.description: topological_sort uses .expect() when decrementing in-degrees. Corrupted DB with dangling blocked_by references would cause panic.
findings.fix: Replace .expect() with proper error handling or add validation pass. [APPLIED]

findings.title: split() ManuallyDrop invariant relies on caller discipline - no compile-time enforcement
findings.description: split() returns bare Child with no kill-on-drop guarantee. Safety only enforced by documentation, not type system.
findings.fix: Created DetachedProcess newtype wrapping Child with kill-on-drop Drop impl.

findings.title: std::sync::Mutex for HealthTracker needs explanatory comment
findings.description: std::sync::Mutex correct but lacks explanatory comment used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Add comment explaining why std::sync::Mutex is appropriate.
findings.fix_detail: Added explanatory comment for std::sync::Mutex choice

findings.title: ProcessManagerHandle spawn capacity TOCTOU - count check and insert not atomic
findings.description: Max capacity check reads map length, then spawns, then inserts. Between check and insert, another task could also pass, allowing oversubscription.
findings.fix: Pre-reserve slot or use atomic counter before spawning.
findings.fix_detail: Moved capacity check into Phase 4 (same lock as insert) to close TOCTOU; kill child on oversubscription

findings.title: Counter increments not batched
findings.description: Each counter increment is a separate SQL statement. Batch method would reduce WAL flush overhead.
findings.fix: Add batch_increment method.
findings.fix_detail: Added batch_increment() method combining all counter updates into single SQL statement

findings.title: Missing PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL for WAL mode
findings.description: WAL mode with default synchronous=FULL is unnecessarily cautious. synchronous=NORMAL is safe with WAL.
findings.fix: Add PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL after PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL. [APPLIED]

findings.title: 4MB limit allocates full buffer before rejecting oversized messages
findings.description: IPC protocol reads up to 4MB into Vec before checking size limit. Large messages fully allocated before potential rejection.
findings.fix: Consider streaming serialization or incremental size checking.

findings.title: serde_yaml deprecated
findings.description: serde_yaml is officially deprecated. Should migrate to serde_yml.
findings.fix: Replace serde_yaml with serde_yml.

findings.title: dashmap unused in production code paths
findings.description: dashmap declared as workspace dependency but unused in production paths.
findings.fix: Remove from workspace deps or move to dev-dependencies.
findings.fix_detail: Removed from workspace deps and ap-core Cargo.toml

findings.title: Triple underscore ___ not rejected in agent names
findings.description: Agent name validation does not reject ___ which could be confused with the agent__tool separator.
findings.fix: Add explicit check for ___ in agent names. [APPLIED]

findings.title: init --dir does not canonicalize path before validation
findings.description: Symlinks could bypass the .. check.
findings.fix: Call canonicalize() before validation.
findings.fix_detail: Added canonicalize() before validation to resolve symlinks

findings.title: PromotionError has zero test coverage
findings.description: Promotion module writes files to disk and generates manifests but has no tests.
findings.fix: Add unit tests for promotion success and error paths.
findings.fix_detail: Already has 14 tests covering success, error, validation, rollback paths (stale finding)

findings.title: TaskGraphError 4 untested variants
findings.description: Serialization, IncompleteTopoSort, InvalidTransition, InvalidState variants have no test coverage.
findings.fix: Add tests for InvalidTransition and IncompleteTopoSort at minimum.
findings.fix_detail: Added tests for IncompleteTopoSort (dangling deps) and InvalidState (bad state string in DB)

blind_spots: Fuzz testing not performed on IPC/TOML/YAML parsers
No concurrency stress tests for advisory locks
Promotion module has zero test coverage
No SIGTERM/SIGINT handler for own process
